intro: One cat is nice. A basket of kittens is even better! In this unit you will learn to talk about more than one thing in Spanish. Gato becomes gatos. Flor becomes flores.
You will also learn to tell what things are like. Is the dog big or little? Is the girl happy or sad? You will say el perro grande and la niña feliz, and make the words match.
bigQuestion: How do Spanish words change to show how many and what things are like?

timeline.t: Add -s to words that end in a vowel: gato, gatos.
Add -es to words that end in a consonant: flor, flores.
Change z to c before -es: lápiz, lápices.
Change el to los and la to las.
Name big, little, tall, short, happy and sad.
Put the describing word after the thing: el perro grande.
Make words match: la gata pequeña, los perros grandes.

words.d: the cats — add -s after a vowel
the flowers — add -es after a consonant
the pencils — z changes to c, then -es
big — the same for el and la words

test.q: What is the plural of el libro?
test.why: Both words change: el becomes los and libro gets -s.

test.q: What is the plural of la flor?
test.why: Flor ends in a consonant, so add -es, and la becomes las.

test.q: What is the plural of el pez?
test.why: Z changes to c, then add -es: los peces.

test.q: How do you say two cats?
test.why: After dos there is more than one, so add -s: dos gatos.

test.q: How do you say the big house?
test.why: The describing word goes after the thing, and casa goes with la: la casa grande.
Niña goes with la, so alto changes to alta.

test.q: What is the opposite of grande?
test.why: Grande means big and pequeño means little.

test.q: What is the plural of el gato feliz?
test.why: Everything is plural, and feliz changes z to c before -es.

test.q: Which word means the for many la words?
test.why: La becomes las for more than one: las casas.

write.prompt: Draw some animals. Label them or say 3 sentences in Spanish, like: Tres perros grandes. Una gata pequeña. Los gatos felices. Use a number, the thing, and a describing word that matches.
tips: Put the describing word after the thing.
Add -s or -es when there is more than one.
Check el, la, los and las.
